rows.en:
VF-17D Nightmare (Liza)
The unit Liza stole while fleeing smugglers. Whether the bill for it ever reached the Zolan Star Patrol is anybody's guess.
rows.notes: tm reviewed; added 'while' so Liza is the one fleeing, not stealing from fleeing smugglers.

rows.en:
VF-5000T-G Star Mirage
A two-seat VF-5000 of the Zolan Star Patrol. With a Super
Booster fitted, it played a key role in arresting the poachers.

VF-5000G Star Mirage
A VF-5000 of the Zolan Star Patrol. Liza complained that
it carried nothing but non-lethal weapons.

VF-19P Excalibur
The unit Basara forced his way into to sing to the Galaxy
Whale. Whether Ray was billed the rental is anybody's guess.

VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Gamlin)
Gamlin's own unit in his signature black. To let Basara's song
be heard, he fought the poachers without quite knowing why.

VA-C-3 Invader
The poachers' main variable attacker, with harpoon launcher
pods to catch Galaxy Whales and whaling mods all over it.

Diving Suit
The suit Graham Hoilie wore to fight the Galaxy Whale.
Harpoon in hand, he fought the white whale to the death.

Cheyenne II
An anti-air interceptor Destroid, a redesign of the Cheyenne.
It put its firepower to full use in the Macross Attack.

VF-171 Nightmare Plus
Main variable fighter of the Frontier fleet. Weaker than its base
VF-17, but easier for ordinary pilots to handle.

VF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Standard)
A VF-171 refit to fight the Vajra. Mainly flown by rank-and-file
U.N. Forces pilots, it fought to defend the Frontier.

VF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Alto)
Alto's unit as Sagittarius Squadron leader. Hardly a poor
performer, but it couldn't keep up with Alto's skill.

RVF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Luca)
The unit Luca flew when Jeffrey and the others deserted.
For electronic warfare, it is fitted with a radome and Ghosts.

VF-25F Messiah (Alto)
Cutting-edge unit sent to military provider S.M.S., partly for
testing. Alto's F type is built for high-mobility combat.

VF-25S Messiah (Ozma)
The gray unit of Ozma, S.M.S. Skull Squadron's leader. It beats
the standard model, and is formidable with Armored Parts on.

VF-25G Messiah (Michael)
The VF-25's long-range combat custom, painted blue for Michael. Its sniper rifle and long-range head stand out.
rows.notes: Japanese has Mihaeru (not Mishel), so 'Michael' per the brief. Note: u1069 (VF-25G short label) renders the same name as 'Michel'.

rows.en:
RVF-25 Messiah (Luca)
The VF-25's electronic-warfare custom. Luca's is light green.
Has a big back radome and carries remote-piloted drones.

Queadluun-Rhea (Standard)
Evolved Queadluun-Rau with a back beam cannon and better
arm weapons. Deployed mainly as the Pixie Team's mainstay.

Queadluun-Rhea (Klan)
Klan's own unit, in her signature crimson. With Klan's great combat skill, it held its own against even the VF-25 in battle.

Klan Klang
Pixie Team leader Captain Klan Klang, in her macronized form.
Raging and grieving at Michel's death, she mowed down Vajra.

VB-6 Konig Monster
A variable bomber based on the Monster. It excels at mobile
hit-and-run attacks and boasts awesome, unrivaled firepower.

Macross Quarter
Only ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the Macross name.
This agile, hard-hitting ship was once seized by pirates.

Battle Frontier
The linchpin of Frontier's defense: a huge multirole stealth
attack space carrier. In a crisis, it houses the government.

Vajra (S)
Small type of an insect-like alien life form. Its head fires
energy blasts and homing missiles. Its tail blade allows melee.

Vajra (L)
Over 5 times the small type's size, with great firepower: a big
back beam that smashes battleships in one hit, missiles, guns.

VF-27 Lucifer (Standard)
Built from the YF-24 exclusively for cyborg soldiers. Its
mobility is too extreme for a flesh-and-blood body to endure.

VF-27 Lucifer (Brera)
Brera's personal VF-27, in his signature color, purple.
Its high performance troubled Alto's team time and again.

Battle Galaxy
Macross Galaxy's Battle-class carrier. Thought lost in a Vajra
attack, it was in fact part of a plot by Grace and her allies.

YF-25 Prophecy
The VF-25's test model, developed from the YF-24. Its head carries multiple sensors so it can record data.

VF-25A Messiah (Standard)
The basic VF-25, able to take on many tactical roles with optional gear. S.M.S. flies it, partly for performance evaluation.

VF-25S Messiah (Klan)
The commander unit of Klan, S.M.S. Pixie Team leader. Like her Queadluun-Rhea, it bears her signature crimson.

Macross Quarter
Only ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the Macross name. It mounts the Quarter Cannon, with overwhelming destructive power.
rows.notes: 'Quarter Cannon' is not a glossary entry (plain rendering of the katakana).

rows.en:
Hound Vajra
A mantis-like Vajra with scythes on both arms. It caught Ranka in its abdomen to carry her off, but why remains unknown.
rows.notes: Hound Vajra is a provisional glossary entry.

rows.en:
VF-2SS Valkyrie II
The U.N. Forces' main Valkyrie, built with Zentradi technology.
Silvie and others flew it with distinction against the Mardook.

VA-1SS Metal Siren
Built as the U.N. Forces' next main unit. On top of the usual 3 modes, it has a 4th, Gundroid mode, which excels in melee.
rows.notes: 'Gunroid' (gandoroido) mode is not in the glossary; romanized as in Macross II sources. Review: 'Gundroid' (glossary).

rows.en:
Proto Metal Siren
The Metal Siren prototype shown to the public at the Moon Festival. The Mardook, appearing out of nowhere, nearly seized it.
rows.notes: Proto Metal Siren is provisional; 'Moon Festival' is not in the glossary. The prototype itself is what the Mardook nearly carried off (rachi = abduct).

rows.en:
SNN Valkyrie
A civilian variable craft owned by SNN. Unarmed and unable to turn into a Battroid, yet it flew every bit as well as military craft.

Gigamesh (Standard)
The Mardook's main mobile weapon, made for melee, with
claws all over its body and wing cutters on its shoulders.

Gigamesh (Feff)
Personal unit of the Mardook forces' Feff, in his signature red. It fought Silvie fiercely inside the ship as she tried to escape.
rows.notes: Review: restored 'Mardook forces' (in the Japanese, dropped in English). Compressed to keep 2 wrapped lines.

rows.en:
VF-1S Valkyrie (Barnrose)
Personal unit of Mariafokina Barnrose, leader of Vindirance.
Pilot skill or specs? Old as it is, it rivaled the newest units.

VF-19A Excalibur Ravens Type
The VF-19 of special forces unit VF-X Ravens. High-performing
but twitchy, it takes great skill to master.

VF-22 Sturmvogel II (Wilbur)
Personal unit of Wilbur Garland, VF-X Ravens commander.
It showed off its might in purging the rebellious Vindirance.

VF-9 Cutlass (Standard)
General Galaxy's first mass-produced variable fighter. Small and light, it has superb combat mobility.

VF-9 Cutlass (Max)
A unit of the Dancing Skull team. Max's, in his signature blue, tore across the battlefield alongside Milia's.

VF-9 Cutlass (Milia)
A unit of the Dancing Skull team. Milia's, in her signature red, tore across the battlefield alongside Max's.
